overview: The Traffic Commission approved several parking variances, stop sign additions, accessible parking spaces, and regulatory language for parking enforcement fines. The commission tabled a proposed roadway and bicycle lane plan on Boston Avenue associated with Tufts University's Pachyderm Place project following extensive public comment.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes of the September 8, 2026 meeting.

items.title: Permit Parking Variance: 359 Boston Avenue
items.summary: Approved resident permit parking variances on Bellevue Street and Fairmont Street for a student residing on metered Boston Avenue.

items.title: Permit Parking Variance: 9 Edward Place
items.summary: Tabled a request for a second-vehicle parking variance on Edward Street because the applicant was not present.

items.title: Permit Parking Variance: 429 Main Street
items.summary: Approved a G-zone permit parking variance for an essential hospital employee living on Main Street.

items.title: Permit Parking Variance: 305 Riverside Avenue
items.summary: Approved a parking variance on Honeywell Avenue for an applicant whose residential building provides only one off-street space per unit.

items.title: Stop Signs: Fairfield Street at Lincoln Street
items.summary: Approved installing stop signs on Fairfield Street to create an all-way stop at the Lincoln Street intersection based on engineering support and neighbor petitions.

items.title: Veteran Meter Parking Permit
items.summary: Approved creating an annual $25 metered parking permit for Medford veterans, requiring certification from the veterans services director and City Hall purchase.

items.title: 15-Minute Parking: 34 Salem Street
items.summary: Approved moving a 15-minute parking space to the front of Dunkin' at 34 Salem Street and converting the previous 15-minute space at the corner back to metered parking.

items.title: Stop Sign: Elliott Street at Trout Avenue
items.summary: Approved installing a stop sign on the one-way portion of Elliott Street approaching Trout Avenue and Kenway Road to establish an all-way stop.

items.title: Pachyderm Place Boston Avenue Improvements
items.summary: Tabled for one month the street redesign and cross-section plan for Boston Avenue adjacent to Tufts University's 664-bed dormitory project. Bicycle advocates and residents urged the commission to pause for further design alternatives, protected bike lanes, and coordination with an ongoing corridor study.

items.title: Accessible Parking Space: 132 Monument Street
items.summary: Approved a designated on-street accessible parking space in front of 132 Monument Street to facilitate vehicle transfers for a disabled resident.

items.title: Accessible Parking Space: 48 Chipman Street
items.summary: Approved an on-street accessible parking space at 48 Chipman Street for a disabled veteran.

items.title: Accessible Parking Space: 49 Bradshaw Street
items.summary: Tabled an accessible parking space application for 49 Bradshaw Street pending clarification on whether the applicant has access to their private driveway.

items.title: Accessible Parking Space: 36 Evans Street
items.summary: Approved an on-street accessible parking space in front of 36 Evans Street to accommodate frequent medical transportation needs.

items.title: Parking Violations and Schedule of Fines
items.summary: Approved regulatory language prohibiting parking on city streets with expired or missing inspection stickers and registrations or beyond posted time limits, and formally affirmed the existing schedule of parking fines.
